title: Case REQ-20261109-LIF003 — valuation summary
content:
Summary of the business valuation supplied by Marcus Tan, accountant, Bayside Business Accountants, and how the Paraplanning Agent used it for Penny (Paraplanning). Case REQ-20261109-LIF003.

Valuation: Northcote Custom Joinery Pty Ltd is valued at $2,400,000 (100% of the company) at 30 Jun 2026. Life Advice Guru relies on the accountant's valuation and doesn't value businesses itself.
Business: founded 2011; 14 staff; revenue $3.1 million; net profit $520,000.
Ownership: George Papadopoulos 50% (CL-104611); Harpreet Kaur 50% (CL-104612).

Needs (calculations for Amelia, not advice):
1 Buy-sell: each owner's 50% share is 50% × $2,400,000 = $1,200,000, so life and TPD cover of $1,200,000 on each owner. Each partner owns the policy on their own life (self-ownership), backed by a buy-sell agreement that their lawyer drafts.
2 Key person: Marcus estimates that losing George would cost the business about $400,000 of profit over 18 months while a replacement is found and trained, so life and TPD cover of $400,000 on George, owned by the company for a revenue purpose.
3 Total cover on the case: $1,200,000 + $1,200,000 + $400,000 = $2,800,000. That is $2,000,000 or more, so Theo, the Practice Team Leader, gives the advice a second review (see 'Matrix — authority, approvals and escalation').

Tax: how premiums and benefits are treated for buy-sell and key person cover is set out in 'Tax on life insurance — premiums and benefits'. Marcus confirmed the treatment for George and Harpreet as their accountant.

Financial evidence for underwriting: Northbank Life accepts the accountant's valuation and the company's financial statements for the last two years as financial evidence (see 'Northbank Life — Business Protection PDS extract').
